start.text: (Counting coins into her palm, eyes on the machine.) Not now, sorry - it ate my ten rupees and I've got a - (she looks down, at the space beside her) - Adi? ADI?

reunion.text: ADI! Where - don't you EVER - (she has him by both shoulders, then against her, then at arm's length to shout at him again). Sir. Thank you. Thank you, thank you. Dhanyavaadagalu. Spider-Man, say thank you uncle.

after.text: (Adi is wearing her dupatta as a leash now. He waves at you with his free hand.)
